text: In epistemic logic, the KK principle (positive introspection) is captured by Axiom 4: KaP -> KaKaP (if a knows P, then a knows that a knows P). Which property of the accessibility relation corresponds to Axiom 4?
choices: Reflexivity -- every world is accessible from itself.
Symmetry -- if world w' is accessible from w, then w is accessible from w'.
Transitivity -- if w' is accessible from w and w'' is accessible from w', then w'' is accessible from w.
Seriality -- every world has at least one world accessible from it.
explanation: Axiom 4 (positive introspection, the 'KK' principle) corresponds to transitivity of the accessibility relation. Reflexivity corresponds to Axiom T (factivity, KaP -> P); the Euclidean property corresponds to Axiom 5 (negative introspection); seriality corresponds to Axiom D. The KK principle is philosophically contested -- Williamson argues it fails because knowledge requires a margin for error.
